questions.prompt: You raised preflop and are in position on As 7d 2c. A small continuation bet is common because…

choices.text: Your range has the advantage and the board has few draws to charge.
The caller has the nuts more often
Small bets are only for bluffs

questions.explanation: Dry ace-high boards favor the raiser. A small bet denies equity without bloating the pot.

questions.prompt: You raised and are in position on 9h 8h 7c with ace-high and no draw. The better default is…

choices.text: Check back. The board hits the caller’s range.
Bet the size of the pot with air every time
Fold a hand that can still win

questions.explanation: Checking back air and weak showdown on a wet caller board avoids lighting money on fire.

questions.prompt: When you do bet a wet board with a strong hand or a strong draw, the size is usually…

choices.text: Larger than the small dry-board bet, so draws pay.
Smaller than on a dry board

questions.explanation: Charge hands that have equity. A tiny bet on 876 two-tone lets every draw continue.

questions.prompt: Checking back second pair in position is often right because…

choices.text: You have showdown value and keep the caller’s bluffs in.
You should bet only when you will fold to a raise you cannot beat

questions.explanation: A small pair that is ahead of air does not need protection on a dry board as much as it needs a cheap showdown.
